Messages.Author: Jannu
Messages.Body:
Can Dive into madness be played inferior by a vampire with superior dementation? (just to cycle the card)

+1 stealth action.
Dementation This vampire gains superior Dementation until the end of the turn and untaps.
Dementation Put this card on the acting vampire. The vampire with this card gets +1 bleed. Any older vampire can burn this card as a  action. A vampire can have no more than two Dive into Madness cards.

Potence, if it doesn't work, you just aren't using enough
